beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then follow the distinction between selection and the contract that continues after selection.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The full inquiry tests the conditions under which honorable leadership could remain genuinely removable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its value lies in examining how privilege might end without turning correction into destruction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read the human coda to confront the unresolved burden that elegant institutional models leave behind.
